ULME was attacked on BNB Chain on October 25, 2022, when an access control flaw in the buyMiner function enabled mass draining of users' USDT tokens via flash loan. The attacker profited about $50,646 BUSD, and total losses reached $250,000 across over 100 victim addresses. The buyMiner function in the ULME contract was public and lacked proper access checks. This allowed anyone to call it and withdraw USDT from approved addresses, abusing delegated allowances and draining funds from many users.
